title: STable
html:
定义组：二阶语法与语义。有序参数：F、R、f、r、D、I、J、K、S。

精确含义以本页公式体及其全部依赖为准。

规范公式

(@ STable F R f r D I J K S) 按 无捕获缩写规则 展开为下列有限公式。参数只取集合，不能填入函数项或元语言公式。

(and
  (@ SModel F R f r D I J K)
  (and
    (forall q
      (implies
        (in q S)
        (exists a

            (exists G
              (and (exists z1466 (and (@ Pair e G z1466) (@ Pair a z1466 q))) (@ SSemRow F R f r D K a e G)))))))
    (forall a
      (forall e
        (forall G
          (implies
            (@ SSemRow F R f r D K a e G)
            (iff
              (exists z1467 (and (exists z1468 (and (@ Pair e G z1468) (@ Pair a z1468 z1467))) (in z1467 S)))
              (or
                (exists c

                            (@ FRel c vs a)

                            (@ App r c n)

                            (@ Seq vs n)
                            (and
                            (@ SeqTo ds n D)
                            (and
                            (@ App J c h)
                            (and
                            (in ds h)
                            (forall i
                            (implies
                            (in i n)
                            (exists t (exists d (and (@ App vs i t) (and (@ App ds i d) (@ FTEval F f D I e t d))))))))))))))))))
                (or
                  (exists n
                    (exists j
                      (exists vs
                        (exists ds
                          (exists key
                            (exists h
                            (and
                            (@ SRelVar n j vs a)
                            (and
                            (@ Pair n j key)
                            (and

                            (and
                            (@ Seq vs n)
                            (and
                            (@ SeqTo ds n D)
                            (and
                            (in ds h)
                            (forall i

                            (in i n)
                            (exists t (exists d (and (@ App vs i t) (and (@ App ds i d) (@ FTEval F f D I e t d)))))))))))))))))))
                  (or
                    (exists t
                      (exists u (exists v (and (@ FEq t u a) (and (@ FTEval F f D I e t v) (@ FTEval F f D I e u v))))))
                    (or
                      (exists b
                        (and
                          (@ PNeg b a)
                          (not (exists z1456 (and (exists z1457 (and (@ Pair e G z1457) (@ Pair b z1457 z1456))) (in z1456 S))))))
                      (or
                        (exists b
                          (exists c
                            (and
                            (@ PImp b c a)
                            (implies
                            (exists z1458 (and (exists z1459 (and (@ Pair e G z1459) (@ Pair b z1459 z1458))) (in z1458 S)))
                            (exists z1460 (and (exists z1461 (and (@ Pair e G z1461) (@ Pair c z1461 z1460))) (in z1460 S)))))))
                        (or
                          (exists x
                            (exists b
                            (and
                            (@ FAll x b a)
                            (forall d
                            (implies
                            (in d D)
                            (exists ee
                            (and
                            (@ Update e x d ee)
                            (exists z1462 (and (exists z1463 (and (@ Pair ee G z1463) (@ Pair b z1463 z1462))) (in z1462 S))))))))))
                          (exists n
                            (exists i
                            (exists b
                            (exists H
                            (exists key
                            (and
                            (@ SAll n i b a)
                            (and
                            (@ App K n H)
                            (and
                            (@ Pair n i key)
                            (forall h
                            (implies
                            (in h H)
                            (exists GG
                            (and
                            (@ Update G key h GG)
                            (exists z1464 (and (exists z1465 (and (@ Pair e GG z1465) (@ Pair b z1465 z1464))) (in z1464 S))))))))))))))))))))))))))))
